meta.source: sherdog.com fighter pages (pro fight history), fetched by tools/preufc.py at <= 1 request/s; raw HTML cached in data/raw/sherdog_cache/ (gitignored)
meta.targets: roster (fighters.json) + every fighter with 0-3 prior UFC bouts in a UFC bout on/after 2019-01-01
meta.walk_forward: snapshots[k] uses only Sherdog pro fights dated strictly before the k-th UFC bout's date; rows matched to ufcstats bouts (or any UFC-promoted row) are UFC experience and never count in the non-UFC record; amateur and exhibition (TUF house) fights are excluded from the record (exh_n/exh_w count exhibitions)

fields.n w l d nc: non-UFC pro record before the bout (w+l+d = n)
fields.ko_w sub_w dec_w oth_w / ko_l sub_l dec_: non-UFC wins and losses by method (KO includes TKO; oth = DQ and other)
fields.streak: non-UFC win streak at the end of the non-UFC record (entering the UFC for a debut)
fields.streak_all / lstreak_all: overall pro win / loss streak entering the bout (UFC included)
fields.l5_w l5_n: wins in the last (up to) 5 non-UFC fights
fields.n_ufc_sd: UFC bouts Sherdog lists before this bout
fields.years_active: years from pro debut to the bout
fields.layoff_days: days since the last pro fight of any kind
fields.n_2y: pro fights in the 2 years before
fields.promos / last_promo / n_promos: non-UFC promotions (Sherdog event-name prefix, big orgs merged)
fields.dwcs_w dwcs_n: Dana White's Contender Series wins / fights (not in ufcstats)
fields.promo_feed: mean over the last 6 non-UFC fights of log(1 + number of UFC fighters who came through that promotion and debuted in the UFC before the bout date)
fields.promo_feed_max: max of the same over the last 6 non-UFC fights
fields.promo_grad: mean over the last 6 non-UFC fights of the promotion's graduates' win rate in their first 3 UFC bouts before the bout date (shrunk to 0.5 with 10 pseudo-bouts)
fields.opp_wpct / opp_known: mean pre-fight win share of non-UFC opponents with >= 3 fights seen in the Sherdog network (union of every cached page), and how many such opponents
fields.opp_ufc_w / opp_ufc_n: non-UFC wins / fights against opponents who had a UFC bout before the bout date
fields.net_elo: Elo over every fight in the Sherdog network (K 32, start 1500), as of the bout date
fields.exh_n exh_w: exhibition (TUF house) fights / wins before the bout
fields.fights: [date, result, method class, promotion, opponent, opponent sherdog id, round, ufcstats fight id or 'UFC' for UFC rows ufcstats lacks or '' for non-UFC]
fields.current: the same features as of today (non-UFC record including fights between or after UFC stints)
